$comment: Known weapon-look findings a data release may carry (id: unit|rank|weapon|check), from the 20 Nov 2026 audit of main's data with the fixes of that evening (tools/weapon-fidelity.mjs, docs/WEAPON-FIDELITY.md). "open" is a fault still to fix; "RA2's own" is how Red Alert 2 behaves too (its rules.ini named); "accepted" is a deliberate difference. A finding not listed fails tools/gameplay-check.mjs. Remove a line when its fault is fixed; never add one to pass a release without saying why.
